items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: I met her once and Lizzie Miles introduced me to her as her teacher or something

ctx.x: One that's still around that may could give a little more information on that is a Wilmina Bordette. Do you know that?
I met her once and Lizzie Miles introduced me to her as her teacher or something from backstage of the Mardi Gras about five or six years ago, a long time ago. Yeah. I've never seen her since.
Because she always speaks of Jimmy Newland and the time that they were playing. Really? It looked like she worked with Jimmy for quite some time. You know, now I'm here.
